'''Ol' Sawtooth''' is a mini-boss encountered during the [[Temple of Aminishi]] elite dungeon in the third room. It can be found at the east side of the giant pool with [[sea crocodile]]s and [[waterfiend (Temple of Aminishi)|waterfiends]].

In Story mode its health is reduced by 50% and its damage output is reduced by 90%.
